description: Henrico, VA – Rob Wittman voted again last night to keep the Iran war going as diesel prices hit an all-time high of $6 a gallon and gas in Virginia climbed to $4.14 a gallon. It is the latest in a string of votes Wittman has cast to prolong a war that has already cost American taxpayers an estimated $40 billion and is squeezing families at the pump, in the grocery checkout line, and on their household budgets.

title: Wittman Votes to Continue Iran War as Diesel Hits Record Highs, Virginia Gas Prices Top $4.14/Gallon - Shannon Taylor for Virginia
